oneLineSummary: 5 PR variants 결정화: PPR(Haveliwala 2002, α=0.85), Topic-Sensitive PR(2003), SimRank(Jeh-Widom 2002 sim(u,v) recursive), HITS(Kleinberg 1998 auth/hub eigenvectors), Eigenvector Centrality. 모두 fixed-point/eigenvector 공통.
recommendation: CHU rank span을 5 contracts로 분해; numerical benchmark + reverse-engineer NetworkX/Neo4j 구현.
